title: 第282章 盐铁初摇诸部意，惊澜骤起殿门前
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

蒙兀坐在虎皮座上，沉声道：

“先生远道而来，赐座。”

一名侍卫搬来一张裹着鹿皮的矮凳，搁在殿前侧边。

陈醉看了一眼矮凳，未挪半步，只拢袖长揖：“谢国主，陈某奉千户大人之命，初次拜会，备了些大宁土产薄礼。”

言罢，沐远抬手示意。

室韦卫兵抬着数十口大木箱与麻布袋子置于殿中，解开捆扎的绳索。

前头十几个箱子掀开，里头放着百十口泛着乌光的生铁大锅。

这乌沉沉的铁色一入眼，殿后侍立的各部武士中，顿时起了一阵骚动，一个个伸长了脖子往前张望。

紧接着卫兵又搬出了几箱精钢大斧的斧子头，十数捆锯齿森然的长锯。

陈醉声音和缓：“我家大人说，苍牙堡与额尔木城，百里之地，是邻居。邻居登门，不行虚礼。

带的都是过日子的实在东西。这些生铁锅釜，不过是方便室韦百姓平日里炖煮些热食。至于这些斧锯……

素闻室韦木工天下无双，王城更是巨木为郭，大人特地差我备下这些伐木的行头，权当给贵国工匠添些趁手的器物。”

卫兵手脚不停，继续开箱，后头尽是些砖茶与成色极佳的棉布丝帛。

最后，两名卫兵小心翼翼地抬上一只精致的漆盒。

陈醉伸手掀开漆盒，里头卧着一整套晶莹剔透、温润如玉的秘色瓷茶具。

这套瓷器莹润光洁，如江南月色落于殿中，衬得王座愈显尊崇。

蒙兀面上难掩异彩，身子不由自主地往前倾了半分，连声道好。

陈醉缓步走向殿中几只半人高的麻布袋。

他抬手，去解腰间的短匕。

"锵"地两声，殿柱旁两名室韦卫士跨步而出，抽出腰刀。

陈醉手中动作未停，轻轻一笑，两指捏着三寸小匕，自鞘中缓缓抽出。

王座之上，蒙兀摆了摆手。

两名卫士对视一眼，还刀入鞘，退回柱旁。

陈醉朝王座方向微一颔首，俯身，刀尖挑住袋口缝线，轻轻一旋。

他攥住麻袋一角，向下一扯。

一袋子物事如白瀑般倾泻而出，“哗啦”一声堆在了一块上好的黑色熊皮上。

盐色雪白晃眼，细如冬雪，纯净无杂。

于长年吞咽天狼带沙苦盐的室韦人而言，此等白雪，刺目胜金。

大殿之内，静谧无声。

几名定力稍差的武将，竟不自觉地往前迈出半步。

陈醉将短匕收至袖中，负手立于这堆白雪旁，仰头直视蒙兀：

“我家大人在云州主政落马坡互市，素闻室韦部族英勇。这些茶帛、铁锅与细盐，不过是给国主及诸位的见面礼。大人放了话，大宁的物产，室韦若是有缺，他愿敞开大门。”

座下左首，一名颧骨高凸的汉子忽地冷嗤出声。

“大宁人最是狡诈！”此人正是札达部头人，莫敦。

莫敦单手按在交椅扶手上，皮笑肉不笑道：

“天狼使者的马蹄印还没被风吹平，陈先生就拉着盐铁赶到了。世上哪有这么巧的买卖？拿点盐铁，就想套我们室韦的勇士去给你们宁人挡天狼？你们那位千户大人的套马索，甩得可真够远的！”

Page (1/3)

Mengwu sat on the tiger skin seat and said in a deep voice:

"Sir, you have come from afar to offer me a seat."

A guard brought a low stool wrapped in deerskin and placed it on the side of the hall.

Chen Zui glanced at the low stool, without moving even half a step, he just folded his sleeves and bowed his head: "Thank you, Your Majesty, Mr. Chen, on the orders of Lord Qianhu, has prepared some small gifts of local products from Daning for his first visit."

After saying this, Mu Yuan raised his hand to signal.

Shiwei guards carried dozens of large wooden boxes and linen bags and placed them in the hall, and untied the ropes.

The first dozen boxes were opened, and inside were hundreds of pig iron cauldrons glowing with black light.

As soon as this dark iron color came into view, there was a sudden commotion among the warriors standing behind the palace, and they all stretched their necks and looked forward.

Immediately afterwards, the guards brought out several boxes of fine steel ax heads and dozens of bundles of long saws with sharp teeth.

Chen Zui's voice was gentle: "My master said that Cangya Castle and Ermu City, a hundred miles apart, are neighbors. When neighbors come to the door, they should not be polite.

All I brought with me were practical things for living.These cast iron pots and cauldrons are just for the convenience of people in Shiwei to stew hot food on weekdays.As for these ax saws…

Su Wenshi Wei's carpentry is unparalleled in the world, and the royal city is surrounded by huge trees. Your Excellency has specially sent me to prepare these logging equipment, so I can give your country's craftsmen some handy tools."

The guards kept moving and continued to open the boxes. Behind them were some bricks of tea and cotton and silk of excellent quality.

Finally, two guards carefully carried an exquisite lacquer box.

Chen Zui reached out and opened the lacquer box, and inside lay a set of secret-color porcelain tea sets that were crystal clear and as warm as jade.

This set of porcelain is shiny and clean, like the moonlight from the south of the Yangtze River falling in the palace, making the throne look even more revered.

Meng Wu couldn't hide the excitement on his face, and he leaned forward half a minute involuntarily, saying hello repeatedly.

Chen Zui walked slowly towards several half-person tall sacks in the hall.

He raised his hand to untie the dagger at his waist.

With two "clang" sounds, two Shiwei guards beside the palace pillars stepped out and drew out their sabers.

Without stopping, Chen Zui smiled softly, held the three-inch dagger between his two fingers, and slowly pulled it out of its sheath.

On the throne, Mengwu waved his hand.

The two guards looked at each other, sheathed their swords, and retreated to the pillar.

Chen Zui nodded slightly toward the throne, leaned over, picked up the seam of the bag with the tip of the knife, and twisted it gently.

He grabbed a corner of the sack and pulled it down.

A bag of things poured out like a white waterfall, and was piled on a piece of fine black bearskin with a clatter.

The salt-colored snow is dazzlingly white, as fine as winter snow, pure and unadulterated.

For the Shiwei people who have been swallowing the bitter salt of Sirius' sand for many years, this white snow is more dazzling than gold.

Inside the main hall, there was silence.

Several generals who were less focused took half a step forward unconsciously.

Chen Zui put the dagger into his sleeve, stood beside the pile of white snow with his hands behind his back, raised his head and looked directly at Mengwu:

"My lord is in charge of the Luomapo Mutual Market in Yunzhou, and I have always heard of the bravery of the Shiwei tribe. These tea silks, iron pots and fine salt are just greeting gifts for the king and everyone. My lord has said that if Shiwei is in short supply of Daning's products, he is willing to open the door."

To the left of the seat, a man with high cheekbones suddenly made a cold sneer.

"The Daning people are the most cunning!" This person is none other than Mo Dun, the leader of the Zada ​​tribe.

Mo Dun pressed one hand on the armrest of the chair and said with a smile:

"Mr. Chen arrived with the salt and iron before the horseshoe prints of the Heavenly Wolf messenger were flattened by the wind. How can there be such a coincidence in the world? You want to take some salt and iron and want to trap our Shiwei warriors to help you Ningren block the Heavenly Wolf? Your Lord Qianhu's lasso is really far away!"
